title: Avatar Accessory Registration | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Avatars in CLO 2025.0 allows you to easily register shoes without limitations like left/right distinction or heel assignment. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features
